purpose: Expose immutable mechanical run evidence to an external post-run evaluator without creating a fifth production gate.
allowed_information: authority epoch SHA-256 copied from the immutable run methodology binding
evidence provenance mode limited to fresh full recollection immutable replay or unknown
sealed rate-expectation provider id method class and sample source class
per-stage attempt failure and orphan counts
manual review count and elapsed seconds
report presentation and delivery contract booleans
forbidden_information: positions balances PnL or account state
trade direction entry stop loss or take profit
scores win rates or business conclusions
